exercises.desc: Explosive hip power. Hinge down, scoop the ball low between your legs, then extend your hips hard and toss it forward as far as you can. Full reset every rep — max intent.
exercises.name: Med Ball Scoop Toss

exercises.desc: Rotational power. Half-kneeling, plate starts high on one side — chop diagonally down across your body as fast as possible. Hips stay square, the trunk does the work. 3x5 each side.
exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Plate Chops

exercises.desc: Speed bench, ~60%. Lower under control, then press as fast as possible — the bar should move violently.
exercises.name: Bench Press — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second lowering, 1-second pause on the chest, then drive up. Heavy but controlled.
exercises.name: Bench Press — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Pull as fast as possible — chest-to-bar intent every rep.
exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second lowering to a dead hang, 1-second pause, then pull.
exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Lighter load, press as fast as possible. Ribs down, no lean-back.
exercises.name: Overhead Press — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second lowering to the chest, 1-second pause, drive up.
exercises.name: Overhead Press — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Heavy and controlled. Flat back, row the dumbbell to your hip. Paired with eccentric deficit push-ups.
exercises.name: DB Row

exercises.desc: Shoulder health. Hands on plates or books for a deficit — 4-second lowering, chest below your hands, press up strong. Ribs down, glutes tight, pain-free range only.
exercises.name: Eccentric Deficit Push-Up

exercises.desc: Anti-rotation core. Press straight out from your chest and resist the pull — don't let your trunk rotate. 3x12 each side, ribs down.
exercises.name: Pallof Press

exercises.desc: Max height. Land soft, stick the landing, step down — never jump down.
exercises.name: Box Jump

exercises.desc: Max distance. Full reset between reps — every jump is a fresh max effort.
exercises.name: Broad Jump

exercises.desc: First-step speed. Explode out of your stance — full recovery between reps. Log your time if you have it.
exercises.name: 10-Yd Sprint

exercises.desc: Light load — jump as high as possible. Land soft with a flat back.
exercises.name: Trap Bar Jump

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: hinge with a flat back, 4-second lowering, 1-second pause at the bottom, drive through the floor.
exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Lighter load, drive up as fast as possible. 2x5 each leg.
exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second lowering, 1-second pause at the bottom, drive up. 2x5 each leg.
exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Full-body power. Reach tall, then throw the ball down-forward as hard as you can. Paired with lateral bounds.
exercises.name: Med Ball Overhead Throw

exercises.desc: Push side to side, stick each landing on one leg for a beat. 3x5 each side. Paired with med ball overhead throws.
exercises.name: Lateral Bound

exercises.desc: Band across your back for resistance — explode up so your hands leave the floor. Land soft. Paired with med ball rotational throws.
exercises.name: Banded Plyo Push-Up

exercises.desc: Rotate and throw as hard as you can, like a swing. 3x5 each side. Paired with banded plyo push-ups.
exercises.name: Med Ball Rotational Throw

exercises.desc: Lighter dumbbells, press as fast as possible.
exercises.name: Incline DB Press — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second lowering, 1-second pause, drive up.
exercises.name: Incline DB Press — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Heavy only — no explosive split. Opposite knee and hand down, other leg extended straight behind you. Row the dumbbell without letting your trunk rotate. 4-second lowering. 3x8 each arm.
exercises.name: Bird Dog Row

exercises.desc: Controlled — slight bend in the elbow, lead with the elbows to shoulder height. Paired with face pulls.
exercises.name: Lateral Raise

exercises.desc: Pull to your forehead, elbows high, squeeze your shoulder blades. Shoulder health. Paired with lateral raises.
exercises.name: Face Pull

exercises.desc: Anti-rotation core. Low back pressed into the floor — opposite arm and leg extend slow without any rotation. 3x8 each side.
exercises.name: Dead Bug

exercises.desc: Push side to side, stick each landing. 3x4 each side.
exercises.name: Lateral Bound

exercises.desc: Forward hops on one leg — quick ground contact, stick the last one. 3x5 each leg.
exercises.name: Single-Leg Hop

exercises.desc: Build to top speed. 2–3 minutes rest between reps — full recovery.
exercises.name: 20–30 Yd Sprint

exercises.desc: Lighter load, drive up as fast as possible. Stay tight.
exercises.name: Back Squat — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second descent, 1-second pause at the bottom, drive up.
exercises.name: Back Squat — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Hinge fast — hips back then snap through. Lighter load, max intent.
exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift — Explosive

exercises.desc: ECCENTRIC 4-1-X: 4-second hinge down feeling the hamstrings load, 1-second pause, drive hips through.
exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift — Heavy (Eccentric)

exercises.desc: Outfield first step. Drop step like tracking a ball over your shoulder, then sprint. 3x5 each direction. Paired with med ball slams.
exercises.name: Drop-Step Drill

exercises.desc: Full body — reach tall, then throw the ball through the floor as hard as you can. Paired with drop-step drills.
exercises.name: Med Ball Slam

name: Phase 1 — 4-Day Upper/Lower (Bobby)
notes: Phase 1 — run for 4 weeks. Mon = Day 1 Upper, Tue = Day 2 Lower, Thu = Day 3 Upper, Fri = Day 4 Lower.
Heavy sets = ECCENTRIC emphasis: 4-second lowering, 1-second pause, then drive up.
Explosive sets = max intent, lighter load, full rest between sets. All explosive sets are 5 reps or fewer.
Sprints = full recovery between reps. This is speed work, not conditioning.
Add a rep or a little weight each week.
